value.rationale: The exact equality point m=1/(h+B) is the biologically meaningful boundary where a positive Allee population disappears and the source detects loss of the quadratic local drift. The proof identifies global extinction from any initially occupied pair of patches, and shows an order-of-magnitude change in the time needed to approach extinction across this codimension-two cancellation: t^-1 versus t^-1/2 with universal amplitudes and a measurable nullcline lag. These quantitative critical predictions exceed a routine local stability label; the center-normal-form background is fully credited.
